source: TabbyAPI common/config_models.py and backends/exllamav3/model.py at 7208273 (theroyallab/tabbyAPI main, 2026-09-21), driving exllamav3 built from github.com/vcruz305/exllamav3 master at 329e051; names follow the 1.5.0-dflash2 registry file, plus the dynamic-draft knobs this build is tuned around.
notes: NOT an upstream exllamav3 release. github.com/vcruz305/exllamav3 at 329e051 (2026-09-20) is upstream master at v1.5.0 plus the fork's own commits: aarch64 guards for the x86-only CPU sources (CPU MoE offload and the tensor-parallel CPU reduce are stubbed, the spin loops use the ARM yield hint), int8-weight kernels for the hyperconnection (GatedResidual) decode mixers (EXL3_GR_INT8, default on), a pruned 64K-column draft lm_head for the qwen4_exp MTP head (EXL3_MTP_HEAD_N, default 65536), a batched MTP verify with a device-resident draft chain, and a per-expert mixed-K MoE kernel for mixed-K packs. It is the engine of the vcruz305 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next EXL3 DGX Spark recipe. Several knobs are environment variables, not arguments, and do not enter the fingerprint; results record them in engine.env. Results on it were served through TabbyAPI, so args carry TabbyAPI's config values under the names below. Defaults are TabbyAPI's, which is what canonicalization drops: cache-quant fp16, draft-cache-quant fp16, max-chunk-size 2048, draft-mode model, dynamic-draft false, draft-confidence 0.4 (the Generator default, which stock TabbyAPI never overrides).

params.name: model-dir
params.help: EXL3 model directory. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: max-seq-len
params.help: Maximum sequence length per request. TabbyAPI: max_seq_len (defaults to min(model max_position_embeddings, cache_size)).

params.name: cache-size
params.help: Paged KV cache size in tokens, a multiple of 256; larger than max-seq-len leaves room for prefix caching across requests. TabbyAPI: cache_size.

params.name: cache-quant
params.help: KV cache quantization of the target model. TabbyAPI: cache_mode, which also accepts a k_bits,v_bits pair (3,3 is written as 3).

params.name: gpu-split
params.help: Per-GPU VRAM budget in GiB.

params.name: tensor-parallel
params.help: Split each layer across GPUs instead of splitting by layer.

params.name: rope-scale
params.help: Linear RoPE scaling factor.

params.name: rope-alpha
params.help: NTK-aware RoPE alpha.

params.name: max-batch-size
params.help: Maximum concurrent sequences. TabbyAPI: max_batch_size; left unset it resolves to 4 for models with recurrent layers (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's gated DeltaNet) and 32 otherwise. With a draft attached every slot reserves its own verify history on the recurrent layers.

params.name: max-chunk-size
params.help: Prefill chunk size. TabbyAPI: chunk_size.

params.name: draft-mode
params.help: Speculative decoding path. mtp uses the multi-token-prediction head inside the target pack (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next ships one, 3-bit); model loads a separate draft model; ngram needs no draft weights. TabbyAPI: draft_model.draft_mode.

params.name: draft-gpu-split
params.help: Per-GPU VRAM budget in GiB for the draft head or draft model. TabbyAPI: draft_model.draft_gpu_split.

params.name: draft-model
params.help: Draft model served beside the target, recorded as <hf_id>@<revision>. TabbyAPI: draft_model.draft_model_name inside draft_model_dir.

params.name: draft-cache-quant
params.help: KV cache quantization of the draft model. TabbyAPI: draft_model.draft_cache_mode; the k_bits,v_bits pair form needs the one-line config-model change noted on results that use it.

params.name: draft-num-tokens
params.help: Maximum tokens drafted per step. TabbyAPI: draft_model.draft_num_tokens; unset, the generator takes the draft's default_draft_size (4 for the qwen4_exp MTP head). With dynamic-draft it is the ceiling.

params.name: dynamic-draft
params.help: Stop drafting early each round once the running product of draft confidences falls below draft-confidence; draft-num-tokens is the ceiling. TabbyAPI: draft_model.dynamic_draft. chat.py: -dds.

params.name: draft-confidence
params.help: Target acceptance probability for dynamic-draft (the Generator's draft_confidence, calibrated online against observed acceptance). chat.py: -dc. Stock TabbyAPI does not expose it; results that set it carry a two-line TabbyAPI patch that passes draft_model.draft_confidence through, noted on the result.

params.name: template-vars-default
params.help: TabbyAPI `template_vars_default`: chat-template variables applied when a request sends none (for Qwen3.8: `enable_thinking`). A request's `chat_template_kwargs`/`template_vars` takes precedence.

params.name: reasoning
params.help: TabbyAPI reasoning parser: splits text between reasoning-start-token and reasoning-end-token into reasoning_content. Output tokens are unchanged; only where the text lands in the response.

params.name: tool-format
params.help: TabbyAPI tool-call parser (for example qwen3_coder). Unset, tool calls stay in content as text.

params.name: sysmem-recurrent-cache
params.help: TabbyAPI memory.sysmem_recurrent_cache in MB: host-memory cache of recurrent-layer states for prefix reuse.

params.name: recurrent-checkpoint-interval-pp
params.help: Tokens between recurrent-state checkpoints during prompt ingestion (rounded up to a multiple of max-chunk-size). TabbyAPI: recurrent_checkpoint_interval_pp.

params.name: port
params.help: Bind port. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: verbose
params.help: Verbose logging. Dropped from the fingerprint.
